DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座のご相談ですね。どのように利用する予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss an account. How are you planning to use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい職場の給与を受け取るためです。会社から書類をもらいましたが、この銀行で開けばよいのか読み切れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与受取り目的でこの銀行が指定か案内を読めていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: To receive my salary from a new workplace. The company gave me some documents, but I have not fully understood whether I should open it at this bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the account is for receiving salary, but you have not understood whether this bank is specified in the guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社の指定は、その案内を見て確認しましょう。ご自身で準備したものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the company's instructions in that guidance. Have you prepared anything yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人を確認するために使えると思った書類を持ってきました。ただ、住所が今の住まいと違うものもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人確認に使えると思った書類に現住所と異なるものがあると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought documents I thought could be used to verify my identity. Some of them, however, show a different address from my current home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that some documents you thought usable for identification have an address different from your current one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書類の種類と記載内容は担当が確認します。ここで十分と決めず、違う住所を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the document types and their contents. Do not assume they are sufficient here; explain the different addresses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の住所と書類の住所を並べたメモを見せます。何をそろえればよいか、条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現住所と書類住所のメモを見せ何をそろえる条件か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will show a note listing my current address beside the document addresses. I would like to hear the requirements for what I need to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show a note of your current and document addresses and ask what must be provided under the requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状況に合わせた確認ができますね。会社へ口座情報を渡す日も決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will allow checks suited to your situation. Has a date been set for giving the company your account information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内に提出日がありますが、今日必ず開けるとは思っていません。確認が済む時期を聞いてから会社に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 即日開設と思わず確認時期を聞いてから会社へ提出日を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The guidance has a submission date, but I do not assume the account can definitely be opened today. I will ask when the checks can be completed before discussing it with the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you do not assume same-day opening and will ask when checks finish before discussing the submission date with work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会社の案内とメモを担当へお持ちください。利用目的について、ほかに伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take the company guidance and your note to the person in charge. Is there anything else you want to explain about the purpose of the account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず給与の受取りが目的です。案内の指定と必要な書類を確認してから、申込みを進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 給与受取り目的を再確認し会社指定と必要書類が分かってから進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: The first purpose is receiving salary. I would like to proceed with the application after confirming the company's requirements and necessary documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reconfirm in Japanese that salary receipt is the purpose and you will proceed once the company instructions and documents are clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当の確認をご案内します。会社の書類を忘れずに、お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will guide you to the staff's checks. Remember your company documents, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 棚の値札についてお困りですか。どの商品を選んでいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the shelf price tag? Which product are you choosing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この大袋を二つ買いたいのですが、下の値札には小さい容量が書いてあります。同じ商品の値札でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大袋二つを希望するが値札の小容量と同一商品か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want two of these large bags, but the price tag underneath lists a smaller size. Is it the price tag for the same product?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want two large bags but want to check whether the smaller-size price tag refers to the same item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 容量が異なりますね。商品名のほかに、袋の内容量も見比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sizes differ. Let us compare the contents weight on the bag as well as the product name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大袋には五百グラム、値札には二百グラムとあります。袋を別の場所へ戻した人がいたのかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋の五百グラムと値札の二百グラムを比べ置き違いの可能性を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The large bag says five hundred grams, while the tag says two hundred. Someone may have put a bag back in the wrong place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Compare five hundred grams on the bag and two hundred on the tag in Japanese, and mention a possible misplaced item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 棚の置き方だけでは価格は判断できません。商品の番号を確認してお調べします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot determine the price just from its position on the shelf. I will check the product number and look it up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。安いと思って二つ取ったので、正しい価格を聞いてから数を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 安いと思って二つ選んだが正価を聞いてから数を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I took two because I thought they were cheap, so I want to decide the number after hearing the correct price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you chose two thinking they were cheap but will decide the number after learning the correct price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お調べする間、二つともまだかごに入れずにお待ちください。買う量にもご希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: While I check, please wait without putting either one in your basket yet. Do you have a preferred quantity to buy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一週間分を考えています。値段だけでなく、家で使い切れる量かも見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一週間分として価格だけでなく使い切れる量も見直すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am thinking of a week's supply. I will reconsider not just the price but whether I can use all of it at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will reconsider both the price and an amount you can finish as a week's supply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 正しい価格と容量を確かめて比較できますね。ほかの袋と混ざらないよう一つお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can compare after confirming the correct price and size. I will take one so it does not get mixed up with the other bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この袋をお願いします。確認後に大袋一つにするか、小袋にするかを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を渡し確認後に大袋一つか小袋か選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please take this bag. After the check, I will decide between one large bag and a small bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the bag and say in Japanese that you will choose one large bag or a small bag after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、商品の番号で確認してまいります。お声かけありがとうございます。お買い物をゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check using the product number. Thank you for asking. Please enjoy shopping at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 橋のほうへ行かれる予定でしたか。今は工事の掲示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you planning to go toward the bridge? There is currently a construction notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 橋を渡って一周するつもりでした。迂回すると長くなりそうで、今日はその距離を歩けるか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 橋で一周予定だったが迂回の長さを歩けるか不安と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I intended to cross the bridge and make a circuit. A detour seems longer, and I am worried whether I can walk that distance today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you planned a circuit across the bridge but are worried about walking the length of the detour.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一周にこだわらず、途中で戻る道も見てみましょう。どこまでなら歩きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than insisting on a full circuit, let us look at a route where you turn back partway. How far would you like to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この日陰の休憩場所までにしたいです。そこから来た道を戻れば、橋を通らずに済みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日陰の休憩場所まで行き同じ道なら橋を避けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to go only as far as this shaded rest area. If I return the same way from there, can I avoid the bridge?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether going to the shaded rest area and returning the same way avoids the bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図では同じ道を戻れますが、途中の現地案内も見てください。途中で休みたくなったらどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The map allows returning the same way, but please check the signs along the route too. What will you do if you need a rest partway?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休める場所を探して立ち止まります。予定の場所まで無理に行かず、戻ることも考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中で休み必要なら予定の場所まで行かず戻ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will look for somewhere to rest and stop. I will not force myself to reach the planned spot and will consider returning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that if you need a rest partway you may return without going all the way to the planned place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでよいですね。工事側の細い道に入ると近道になるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That sounds good. Taking the narrow path on the construction side is not necessarily a shortcut.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近そうに見えても工事側へ入らず、案内された歩道を使います。帰り道の分岐も覚えておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内歩道を使い工事側へ入らず帰路の分岐を覚えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if it looks close, I will not enter the construction side and will use the indicated walkway. I also want to remember the forks on the return route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the indicated walkway, avoid the construction side, and remember the return-route forks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口側へ戻る矢印を図で確認しましょう。散歩の予定をどなたかに伝えてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the arrows back toward the entrance on the map. Have you told anyone your walking plan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族には一周すると言いました。休憩場所までの往復に変えたと連絡し、帰りは入口の矢印を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一周から休憩場所往復への変更を家族に知らせ入口の矢印で帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I told my family I would make a circuit. I will tell them I have changed to an out-and-back walk to the rest area, and check the entrance arrows on the return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your family in Japanese of the change from a circuit to a return walk to the rest area, and say you will use the entrance arrows coming back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、短い往復からお楽しみください。休みながら、帰り道もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then enjoy a short return walk to start with. Take rests, and take care on the way back too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路のメモをお持ちですね。どこで乗り換えるのか、見づらい所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a route note. Is there anywhere it is difficult to see where to transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 列車の後にバスと書いてあります。全部同じホームで乗り換えると思ったのですが、この矢印の意味がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: すべて同じホームで乗り換えると思った状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says bus after the trains. I thought all the changes were on the same platform, but I do not understand this arrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you had thought all transfers would be on the same platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このメモでは、最初の乗換えは列車同士です。その次は駅を出てバス停へ歩く経路として書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this note, the first change is between trains. The next is written as a route leaving the station and walking to a bus stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 列車を降りるたびにホームを移るのではないのですね。最後の列車を降りたら、改札の外へ出ると読み直しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 改札外へ出る段階があると理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is not a matter of changing platforms every time I get off a train. Reading it again, I see I leave the ticket gates after the last train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand there is a stage where you go outside the ticket gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その順序です。到着したい時刻は決まっていますか。駅からバス停へ歩く時間も見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is the order. Is your desired arrival time fixed? Let us also consider the walking time from the station to the bus stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人と午後二時に会いたいです。列車の時刻だけでなく、バス停まで歩く時間も含めて間に合うか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: バス停への移動時間を接続判断に加える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to meet a friend at two in the afternoon. I want to see whether I can make it including the walk to the bus stop, not just the train times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will include the time walking to the bus stop when evaluating the connection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 接続には余裕を持つ案を比べましょう。このメモの短い乗換え時間が、ご自身に合うとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us compare options that allow enough time for connections. The short transfer time in this note may not suit you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 走って乗るような乗換えは避けたいです。一本早い列車から行く場合と、待ち合わせを遅くする場合を比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 急いで走る乗換えより余裕を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to avoid a connection that requires running to board. I will compare taking a train earlier with moving our meeting later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you prefer enough time rather than a transfer requiring a hurried run.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 比較ができたら、友人にも予定を知らせてください。構内の乗換え表示と、改札外の案内は別々に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have compared, let your friend know the plan too. Check the station transfer signs separately from guidance outside the ticket gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 列車同士の乗換えを確認してから、駅を出た後のバス停も調べます。余裕のある案を友人と相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 列車の移動と駅外のバス停を区別して進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: After checking the train-to-train change, I will also look up the bus stop after leaving the station. I will discuss an option with enough time with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish train transfers from the bus stop outside the station as you proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの移動を分けると、道順を追いやすいですね。表示を確かめながら、ご友人とのお出かけをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Separating the two movements makes the directions easier to follow. Check the signs and enjoy your outing with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のことでご相談ですね。これから申請されますか、それともお持ちの物をご覧になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about a certificate. Will you apply now, or do you want to look at one you already have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 半年前にもらった物を持っています。新しく借りる部屋の契約に使えるなら、もう一度取らずに済ませたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手元の証明書が契約に使えるか未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have one issued six months ago. If I can use it for a contract on a new rental room, I would rather avoid obtaining another.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not confirmed whether the certificate you already have can be used for the contract.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先が求める証明書の名前を確認しましょう。案内に名称が書かれていれば見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the name of the certificate the receiving organization requires. If its name appears in the guidance, please show me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には住所がわかる証明書とだけあります。手元の紙と同じ物だと思いましたが、名前までは確かめていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名称がないまま同じ紙と判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The guidance only says a certificate showing my address. I thought it was the same as the paper I have, but I have not checked the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not decide it is the same document without a name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名称と必要な記載事項を提出先に尋ねると、申請しやすくなります。ご家族の情報も必要か、おわかりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Asking the receiving organization the name and required information will make applying easier. Do you know whether your family's information is needed too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 契約するのは私一人です。家族の情報を載せる必要があるかも、提出先に聞いたほうがよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人分と記載項目を提出先の条件で整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am the only person signing the contract. Should I also ask the receiving organization whether family information needs to be included?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will clarify whose information and which fields are required according to the recipient's conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な範囲を先に確認してください。それから、発行時期について条件があるかも、あわせて尋ねましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the necessary scope first. Also ask whether there are any conditions about when it was issued.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ名前の証明書でも、半年前の物では条件に合わない場合があるのですね。何月以降の発行が必要か聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名称の一致と発行時期の条件を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even a certificate with the same name might not meet the conditions if issued six months ago. I will ask from which month onward it must have been issued.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that matching the document name and meeting its issue-date conditions are separate matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、その回答をもとに、手元の物が使えるか判断してもらいましょう。新しく取る場合の案内は、その後に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, based on their answer, let them judge whether the one you have can be used. Guidance for obtaining a new one can be checked afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書類の名前、載せる情報、発行日の条件を提出先に確かめます。その回答と、この証明書を持って相談に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 証明書を取り直す前に必要条件をそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask the recipient for the document name, information to include, and issue-date conditions. I will bring that reply and this certificate for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will gather the requirements before obtaining a replacement certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 条件をそろえてからなら、申請の迷いが減りそうですね。お持ちの証明書を忘れず、気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Having the conditions ready should reduce uncertainty when applying. Remember your certificate, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の痛みの欄をご覧になっていますね。記入を進める前に、説明が必要な言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the pain section of the medical questionnaire. Before continuing, are there any words you need explained?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持続という字がわかりません。手首が痛いのですが、その欄に印をつけてよいのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 痛みの続き方の欄を理解してから記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not understand the word persistent. My wrist hurts, but I am unsure whether to mark that field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will understand the field about how pain continues before filling it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここでは痛みが続いているかを尋ねています。ずっと痛むのか、痛まない時間もあるのか、ご自身の言葉で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here it asks whether the pain continues. Please tell us in your own words whether it hurts all the time or there are times without pain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ずっとではありません。朝は平気で、仕事で物を動かすと痛むことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 痛みのない時もあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not all the time. It is fine in the morning, but sometimes hurts when I move things at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that there are times when you have no pain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 痛まない時間もあるのですね。どんな動きをしたときに気づくか、もう少し詳しくお話しできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: So there are times without pain. Could you explain a little more about which movements make you notice it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右手首をひねってふたを開けると気づきます。手を休めているときは、同じ痛みは感じません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ひねる動作と安静時の違いを言葉で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I notice it when twisting my right wrist to open a lid. When resting my hand, I do not feel the same pain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the difference between twisting and resting your hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その違いを問診票にも書いておきましょう。言葉がわからないまま印をつけるより、いまの説明が状況を伝える助けになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us write that difference on the questionnaire too. Your explanation now helps convey the situation better than marking a box without understanding the word.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わからないのに、はいとうなずかないようにします。難しい言葉の代わりに、自分がした動きで説明してもよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 聞かれたことが不明なら確認して答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will avoid nodding yes when I do not understand. I can explain with the movement I made instead of difficult terminology, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that if you do not understand what is asked, you will check before answering.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、理解できない質問は聞き返してください。痛みの原因や治療については、診察で医師へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please ask again about questions you do not understand. Consult the doctor during your examination about the cause of pain and treatment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ふたを開けるときと休んでいるときの違いを書きます。診察でも、質問の意味がわからなければ確かめてから答えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 症状の場面を記録しわからない説明を聞き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write the difference between opening a lid and resting. During the consultation too, I will check before answering if I do not understand a question.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record the circumstances of symptoms and ask again about explanations you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自身の言葉で違いを説明できましたね。問診票をお持ちになってお待ちください。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have explained the difference in your own words. Please wait with your questionnaire. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯電話に届いた連絡が心配なのですね。何を求める内容だったか、操作せずに見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are worried about a message on your phone. Could you show what it requested without taking any action on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 再配達のために払うよう書かれています。でも荷物を注文していないので、何の連絡か心当たりがありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再配達の短文に心当たりがなく不安だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says to pay for redelivery. But I have not ordered a parcel, so I do not recognize what this contact is about.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you do not recognize the redelivery message and feel worried.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送信者が表示されていても、それだけで正しい連絡とは判断できません。相手が名乗った名称は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even if a sender is displayed, that alone does not establish that it is legitimate. What name did the sender give?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 配達会社らしい名前ですが、本当にその会社から来たかはわかりません。表示名だけを見て信じそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社名らしい文字だけで正規の連絡と決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: A name that looks like a delivery company, but I do not know whether it really came from that company. I nearly trusted it just from the display name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not treat it as legitimate solely because the text resembles a company name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 不明な点を分けて確認しましょう。リンクを開いたり、支払いの情報を入力したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate the unknown points and check them. Have you opened the link or entered payment information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。昨日の夜と今朝に届いたので、受信時刻が見える画面を保存しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: リンクや決済を使わず元の画面を残していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Neither. It arrived last night and this morning, so I saved the screens showing the receipt times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not used the link or payment and have kept the original screens.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元のメッセージも消さず、相談するときに確認できる状態にしておいてください。ここでは内容と状況を順番に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not delete the original messages either; keep them available for checking during a consultation. Here we will ask about the content and circumstances in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 読みにくい文字を自分で書き直さず、元の画面を残します。二回分の時刻も、そのまま見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 文字を書き換えず相談用の受信情報を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep the original screen rather than rewrite hard-to-read characters myself. I will also show both receipt times unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will organize the received information for consultation without rewriting the text.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その記録で確認しましょう。配達会社へ問い合わせる場合も、その短文のリンクを使う前に、確認できる連絡先を調べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check those records. Even when contacting the delivery company, look up a verifiable contact before using the message's link.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 以前使った会社の案内で連絡先を確認します。返答を急いで送らず、新しい通知が来たら記録して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メッセージのリンクに頼らず担当へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check contact details in guidance from a company I used before. I will not rush to reply, and if another notice arrives I will record it and seek advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consult the staff without relying on the message link.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 何を操作していないかも伝えてくださってありがとうございます。ご不安な点を担当に相談してから、気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for also explaining what actions you have not taken. Discuss your concerns with the staff, and then take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱をまだ閉じていないのですね。発送の前に、包み方で確認されたいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have not closed the box yet. Is there anything about packing you want to check before sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 衣類と本が入っています。本が箱の中で滑って、持つと重さが片側に寄るので、このままでよいか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱の中身と底への負担を発送前に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It contains clothes and books. The books slide inside, and the weight shifts to one side when I lift it, so I am worried about sending it like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese what is in the box and explain the strain on its bottom before shipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身が動く状態ですね。箱の状態も見ますが、いまは軽く持ち替えるだけにして、無理に振らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The contents are moving. We will look at the box too, but for now only change your grip gently and do not shake it forcefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 動きを確かめようとして振りそうでした。隙間が多いので、詰め直すか、箱を小さくすることも考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱の外寸だけで発送を決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I nearly shook it to check the movement. There is a lot of empty space, so I am considering repacking or choosing a smaller box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not decide on shipping just from the box's outer dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓口で状態を確認してから梱包を整えましょう。詰め直したあとの大きさと重さで、送り方を相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the condition at the counter before arranging the packing. You can discuss shipping methods using the size and weight after repacking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先にこの大きさで料金を決めるのではないのですね。箱を選び直してから、閉じる前にもう一度見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱を選び直してから測定と料金確認へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So we should not fix the price based on this size first. After choosing a different box, could you look again before I close it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose a new box before proceeding to measurement and price confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる範囲をご案内します。送り先の住所と、希望する到着時期もおわかりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain what we can check. Do you know the destination address and desired arrival period?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族の住所はこの紙にあります。日付は決めていませんが、送ったあと家族に到着の目安を伝えたいので、追跡の方法も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族に保証でない到着目安を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family's address is on this paper. I have not fixed a date, but want to tell them an estimated arrival after sending, so I also want to know how to track it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your family an arrival estimate rather than a guarantee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用できる方法と見込みを確認しましょう。見込みは確約と違うので、家族にもそのように伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the available methods and estimates. An estimate is different from a promise, so explain it that way to your family too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 詰め直した箱で方法と料金を確認し、控えを保管します。家族には確定した到着日ではなく、確認できた目安を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 詰め直し後に条件を確認して発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check methods and prices with the repacked box and keep the receipt. I will give my family the confirmed estimate, not a fixed arrival date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the conditions after repacking before sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 箱を整えてから相談する順序が決まりましたね。宛先も確かめて発送し、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have decided to arrange the box before seeking advice. Confirm the address before sending, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の確認画面で止めていらっしゃるのですね。案内と違う表示が出ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have stopped at the transfer confirmation screen. Did something appear that differs from the guidance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃の案内は大家さんの名前ですが、画面には会社名が出ています。違いが気になって、実行はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 個人名と会社名の違いを確定前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The rent guidance has my landlord's name, but the screen shows a company name. I was concerned about the difference and have not executed the transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss in Japanese the difference between the personal and company names before confirming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確定せずに確認しましょう。会社名が表示された理由は、管理会社や大家さんから説明されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check without confirming. Has the management company or landlord explained why a company name appears?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 説明はありません。番号を入力できたから合っていると思いましたが、名義が違ってよいかは確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号を入力しただけで正しい振込先と決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No explanation. I thought it was right because I could enter the number, but have not checked whether a different account name is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that entering a number alone does not establish the correct transfer destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらから、その口座でよいと判断することはできません。契約書など、以前から確認できる連絡先で問い合わせられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot decide that this account is suitable. Can you inquire using previously verifiable contact details, such as those on your contract?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 契約したときの管理会社の連絡先があります。そこで、この会社名が家賃の受取先か確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新たな指示を独断で振込に使わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the management company's contact details from when I signed the contract. I will ask them whether this company name is the rent recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not use new instructions for a transfer on your own judgment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 回答が来るまでは、そのまま進めないでください。振込先が確認できたら、案内と画面の情報をもう一度照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not proceed until you receive an answer. After confirming the destination, compare the guidance and screen information again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入力をやり直す場合も、一から見比べます。受取先が合ってから、手数料を含む支払額も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取情報と手数料を両方確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if I enter it again, I will compare everything from the start. After the recipient is right, can I also check the payment amount including fees?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check both recipient information and fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用する方法の確認画面や窓口の案内をご覧ください。費用がわからない項目は、確定の前にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at the confirmation screen for your chosen method or the counter guidance. Ask about any cost you do not understand before confirming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はまだ振り込んでいないと覚えておきます。名義の回答を待ち、情報と費用を見直してから進めるか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名義の回答が来るまで振込を進めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will remember I have not transferred anything today yet. I will wait for the account-name answer and review information and costs before deciding whether to proceed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not proceed with the transfer until the account-name answer arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未確認のまま進めずに相談できましたね。案内の紙を忘れずにお持ちになって、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You sought advice without proceeding with unconfirmed information. Remember to take the guidance paper, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買い上げは食品と洗剤ですね。入れる袋はお持ちになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your purchases are food and detergent. Have you brought a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋は一つありますが、全部は入りません。洗剤とパンを一緒に詰めたくないので、袋を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食品と洗剤を一つの持参袋に詰めたくないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have one, but everything will not fit. I do not want the detergent and bread together, so I would like separate bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you do not want to pack food and detergent together in your one brought bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持参の袋を食品に使い、洗剤用に追加の袋をご希望でしょうか。必要な大きさを見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Would you like to use your own bag for food and add a bag for detergent? Let us check the size needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、食品は自分の袋に入れます。洗剤のボトルが入る袋を一枚追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗剤を分けるため必要な袋を具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the food will go in my bag. I would like one extra bag that fits the detergent bottle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese the bag needed to keep detergent separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加の袋について、レジの料金表示を確認してください。お支払いの方法もお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the checkout price display for the extra bag. Have you decided how to pay too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋代を先に見せてください。それから、このカードの表示を見て、使える支払い方を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加袋を会計に入れる前に条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please show me the bag price first. Then I would like to check this card's wording to see which payment methods can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will confirm conditions before adding the extra bag to the bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できるかを確認します。二つの方法を組み合わせたい場合も、実行する前にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check whether it can be used. If you want to combine two methods, tell us before the payment is executed too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カードで一部を払い、残りを現金にできるか知りたいです。できると決めつけず、条件を聞いてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残りを現金にする組合せが可能か確認して決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to know whether I can pay part by card and the rest in cash. I will not assume it is possible; I will choose after hearing the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check whether combining cash for the remainder is possible before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: このレジでの扱いを調べます。組合せが使えない場合は、一つの方法をお選びいただくことになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check how this register handles it. If the combination cannot be used, you will need to choose one method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 組合せが使えなければ現金で払います。袋代を含む合計を見て、食品は持参袋、洗剤は追加の袋に分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用不可なら現金で払う方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: If the combination is unavailable, I will pay cash. I will check the total including bags and put the food in my bag and detergent in the extra one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you plan to pay cash if the method is unavailable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋とお支払いの希望を順に伝えてくださってありがとうございます。袋のお忘れ物に気をつけて、またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for explaining your bag and payment preferences in order. Take care not to leave any bags behind, and please come again.
